description: Retrieval golden set. Each query lists substrings that MUST appear in the retrieved chunks for retrieval to be correct. The optional 'expected_doc' (substring of the source document's name) additionally scores DocHit@k and DRM@k — document-retrieval mismatch. These entries are ILLUSTRATIVE (Indian Constitution) and MUST be verified/extended against your own indexed corpus before the numbers mean anything. Aim for 30-50 real queries.

queries.query: Which article ensures equality before the law?
What is the right to freedom of speech and expression?
